On its proposed boundaries, the national park will be located on the North Coast of New South Wales passing through towns including Kempsey, Nambucca Heads, Coffs Harbour, Woolgoolga and Sawtell. This park will protect 176,000 hectares of state forests and merge existing reserves. The park will be inhabited by koalas and many other threatened species including greater gliders, glossy black cockatoos and many rare plants including species of spider orchid.
The boundaries were added to the government gazette in October 2026. The government is creating this national park in order to fulfil an election commitment made in 2023.


== History ==
The original ideas leading to this proposal were formulated in 2010. A survey was commissioned, due to alarm surrounding declining koala populations. Former national parks officer Ashley Love has been credited by the government and conservation groups with developing early iterations of the proposal.
